summary: Guard stable identity upgrades, restore collisions and explicit fleet admission across all CLI paths.

replay.detail: No history rewriting, fake exits or local receipt trimming.

schema.detail: Pre-migration identity inspection checks legacy table columns and leaves schema changes to the normal store migration. Pin writes synchronize the directory after atomic publication.

rules.detail: No membership, checkpoint or delivery admission changes.

compatibility.detail: Fleet create and both migration roles record their explicit admission under the state lock. Fleet controls, including leave's live-runtime check, use the resolved pinned identity. A Claude identity-only invocation remains an error; installer preflights plugin-disable support before marketplace or plugin changes.

downtime.detail: Installed-service membership creation stops its daemon before admission and restarts afterward; foreground daemons must be stopped explicitly. No affected-machine deployment or service mutation was executed in verification.

manual.detail: For ambiguous legacy receipt hosts or disagreement with fleet membership, back up state/config and restore the prior compatible binary with its verified writer while the operator checks keys and live ownership. Restore a corrupted pin only from a known-good backup for this state. Never clone a live state's pin/keys onto another active machine. Claude must support plugin disable; unsupported versions fail before plugin activation.

recovery.detail: Claim restore requires a fresh state directory without an old identity pin; a restored writer conflicting with a pin reports this explicitly. Resume a saved join if admission persisted before its pin write. Local checkpoint matching prevents accidental inconsistency, not edits by the filesystem owner.
